vb_textbox.text: Match the gnomes in the following order based on colour as they work in teams: red + purple // and green + brown.Once less than a 3 mushroom yield, then switch over to the other colours (e.g. from red + purple rotating, to green + brown).It  also seems that when it's the same gnome in a row the number goes down by 1 (in terms of yield) e.g green and green in a row, whereas green + brown rotating keeps the yield going up/stronger for longer, but this is just something I think I noticed. With the time short, just do what you can :)
